messages.author: 4a344f0b5d9a00f2
messages.subject: qplot error: initRefFields
parts:
Sorry to bother, but I got this error when running R version 2.14.0
(2011-10-31) under OsX Lion. This code worked in the prior version of
R. Can anyone help?

> head(mir.melt)
Type Year incidence
1 Cerv 2000 0.001477105
2 Panc 2000 0.000000000
3 Test 2000 0.000000000
4 Thy 2000 0.001477105
5 Leukemia 2000 0.001477105
6 HNC 2000 0.000000000

> a <- qplot(Year, incidence, data = mir.melt, geom = "point", cex = I(2), xlab = "Year", ylab = "Incidence", main = "UNC") + geom_bar(fill = "red") + facet_wrap(~ Type)
Error in initFields(scales = scales) :
could not find function "initRefFields"
